title: Executing a data management sequence from a combo box in a dashboard
author: Unknown
content: I need to execute a data management sequence selected from a combo box in a dashboard using a button.
solution_text: In Button Settings under Action > Server Task, set Selection Changed Server Task to 'Execute Data Management Sequence' and use parameter substitution in the arguments: {|!YourParameterThatControlsTheDMSequence!|}{Param1=[|!DashboardParameter1!|]}
